timing.summary: c1 is introduced: the saved-exponent restoration was added after the change, and the fixed old harness cannot execute it.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established the target coverage obligation; this turn compares its timing only.

before.requirement: Execute saved-exponent state restoration in parse_ex.
before.reason: The complete before function proceeds from number-state local initialization directly to scanning; this restoration did not yet exist.

after.requirement: Execute saved-exponent state restoration by continuing an unfinished number in another parse_ex call on the same tokener.
after.reason: The new branch inspects a previously saved number buffer. The fixed harness makes one parse call on a fresh tokener and then frees it.
